info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Auto Insurance Quotes Discounts-v1-spec
info.description: This API enables users to access a list of available discounts for auto insurance quotes. It provides essential data regarding various discount options that can be applied to insurance policies, helping customers save on their premiums. Typical consumers include insurance brokers, car dealerships, and independent agents who assist clients in finding the most cost-effective insurance solutions. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their service offerings and empower consumers with valuable insights into potential savings.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve all available discount options that can be applied to quotes. It provides detailed information about each discount, including eligibility criteria and applicable conditions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve discount quotes. It allows the caller to specify the necessary parameters needed to get the relevant discounts applicable to the quotes.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of discounts.
